# terrakube_policy_set_parameter (Resource)

Create and manage an OPA Policy Set Parameter in Terrakube. Parameters are key-value inputs passed directly to Rego policy evaluation at runtime under `data.terrakube.inputs.<key>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "terrakube_policy_set" "guardrails" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  name         = "blast-radius-guardrails"
}

# Available in Rego as data.terrakube.inputs.max_resource_changes
resource "terrakube_policy_set_parameter" "max_changes" {
  policy_set_id = data.terrakube_policy_set.guardrails.id
  key           = "max_resource_changes"
  value         = "50"
  description   = "Maximum number of resources a single plan may change"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Parameter key identifier, referenced in Rego as data.terrakube.inputs.<key>
- `policy_set_id` (String) Target Policy Set ID
- `value` (String) Parameter value (supports strings, numbers, booleans, and JSON structures)

### Optional

- `description` (String) Parameter description or documentation

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Parameter ID (UUID)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Policy set parameter can be imported with policy_set_id,id
terraform import terrakube_policy_set_parameter.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000,00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
